claims: Evernorth entered a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with CF Principal Investments LLC for up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares.
The issuer may elect to sell shares from time to time; it is not obligated to use the full commitment.
Potential proceeds may be used for general corporate purposes, including XRP acquisitions and XRP-ecosystem activities.
The upfront commitment fee is $521,893.50, payable under the agreement.
sources.normalized_excerpt_text: Evernorth's October 23, 2026 Form 8-K reports a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with CF Principal Investments LLC for up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares. Evernorth may elect to issue and sell shares from time to time; it is not obligated to draw. The agreement describes the upfront commitment fee and use of proceeds for general corporate purposes, including XRP and XRP-ecosystem activities.

claims: Section 2.1 gives Evernorth sole discretion to issue and sell shares up to the Total Commitment; it has no obligation to sell.
Section 3.1 defines Commencement as initial satisfaction of all Section 7.2 conditions.

Section 7.2 includes company representations/performance, effective resale registration, no material notices, required SEC filings, no trading suspension, compliance, no injunction/litigation, listing, no material adverse effect, no bankruptcy, transfer-agent instructions, share reservation, legal opinions, accountant comfort letters, FINRA no-objection, QIU documentation if required, and investor due diligence.
Section 7.1(iii) requires payment of the $521,893.50 upfront commitment fee within five business days following the registration statement effective date.
